title: findgroups
summary: Find groups and return group numbers.
description: `G = findgroups(A)` assigns one-based group IDs to matching nonmissing values in `A`; missing values receive NaN group IDs.
behaviors: Supports numeric, logical, string, cell, categorical, datetime/duration, multiple grouping inputs, and table variable grouping.
Group IDs are assigned in sorted group-key order.
